title: Quiet week: 2 applications, 1 interview
body:
> [!] Replies came only from jobs posted under 3 days ago

You sent 2 applications and had a first interview.

### Priorities from recurring evidence

Rejections cite missing Kubernetes depth — 3 applications, 2 employers

- Lead the CV with the cluster you ran
- Example Cloud · employer feedback: We need deeper Kubernetes operations · https://jobs.example.com/1
- Alpine Data · interview review: Asked twice about cluster upgrades · https://jobs.example.com/3

### What worked

- The recruiter channel: 2 of 2 replied

### Change next week

- Send the 5 drafted kits
- Apply within 3 days of posting

### Focus

Five applications to fresh postings

### Numbers

- Applications: 12 total, 2 this week; outcomes {'Rejected': 3}; interview rate of decided 25%
- Replies this week: {'Replied': 2}
- Market: 214 open jobs, 120 eligible, 9 need a language you don't have, 31 new this week
- Top technologies in best-fit jobs: Kubernetes 40, Go 10 (not in profile)

### Daily insights this week

- 2026-10-06 · Timing: Replies come within 2 days of applying — Useful
